data.body: Landed via Gerrit change 1051 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1051), merged as e3962d21e with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments. Implemented per plan: (1) criteria_routing.json — T3 and T10 promoted to default_posture=blocking @ block_threshold 0.90 (conservative pilot); T10 trigger text updated to record the DET pre-gate. (2) plan_review_T10.md — one-sentence MAJOR-class severity guidance (only destructive apply / wildcard-overbroad grant / plaintext secret on a committed path / unauthenticated internet-reachable service warrant severity >= major); no pass3_decide changes. (3) T10 DetGateRule 'infra-vocabulary' added to det_gate_rules.py with the audit-verbatim regex, text-only (no file_impact arms). (4) BOTH pinned assertions in tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py updated (full routing table + approved-blocking set, new PILOT_BLOCKING constant), plus the approved-blocking pin in tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py (a third pin discovered by the full-suite run — the deliberate re-approval that pin exists to force). (5) New tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py: posture pins, Pass-3 block@0.92 vs advisory@0.85 for both criteria, DET gate fires on terraform/GHA fixtures and det-gates a pure-docs plan, rubric sentence assertion. (6) docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md regenerated. Gates: make lint + make typecheck green; targeted suites 228 passed; full tests/unit 6047+ passed / 19 skipped after the pin fix.
